scope: Default new Warrior; continuous save; production CombatSimulation at 0.05 s and 1x attendance; seeds=20260924+1337*attempt fixed in advance; no grants, rerolls or retries discarded. Town has zero modeled time. Use earned gear by offense*sqrt(mixed survival) greedy comparison (>0.5%); preserve legendaries and future-level items; sell spare nonlegendaries below 700 gold, otherwise salvage. Fill empty skill slots in catalog order and rank equipped skills evenly. Claim/open all eligible first-clear boxes; choose G01/G03 gems. Craft one missing nonweapon slot when affordable; maintain 700 gold reserve; gear enhancement cap +1 before R5 and +2 thereafter. Two free forge stations, level-2 slot target, real durations. Retry failures; after two consecutive failures at R>1 farm previous rift once. Free daily 120 minutes, no paid recovery, no offline rewards requested. Stop at normal R10 clear or 100 attempts; all attempts persist. This is accelerated production-core play, not manual UI play or a population win-rate estimate.
